message.content:
(1) Overall layout structure: MATCH. Both use a three-pane layout with a navigation sidebar on the left, a central file list, and a details/preview pane on the right.
(2) Information architecture: MATCH. Both place the file tree in the left sidebar, the main data grid (Name, Date/Modified, Type) in the center, and item-specific actions or previews in the right panel.
(3) Color palette family: MATCH. Both utilize a light theme with white backgrounds, light gray borders, and primary blue accents for buttons and selected states.
(4) Typography scale: MATCH. Both use a clear hierarchy with bold headers for columns and standard-weight text for the file list entries and metadata.
(5) Control geometry: MATCH. Both feature a dense list view with row-height consistency, similar checkbox placement on the left of each item, and a prominent blue action button at the bottom right.
(6) Primary CTA placement: MATCH. The "Recover All" / "全部恢复..." button is positioned at the far right of the bottom status/action bar in both interfaces.

VERDICT: STRUCTURALLY_EQUIVALENT. The re-implementation accurately mirrors the spatial organization, component hierarchy, and visual weight of the original product interface.
